label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson Results and Highlights
summary: A 30-second briefing on the biggest stories across golf today.

items.headline: THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim won THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at -18, finishing five strokes ahead of Sungjae Im, Kensei Hirata, Scottie Scheffler, and Wyndham Clark at -13.

items.headline: Sungjae Im Aces Seventh Hole
items.text: Sungjae Im made a hole-in-one on the par-3 seventh and eagled the ninth to shoot a second-round 61 and share the lead at 13-under before finishing T2.

items.headline: Scheffler Misses Wire-to-Wire Win
items.text: Scottie Scheffler failed to repeat as a wire-to-wire winner at his hometown CJ Cup Byron Nelson this year, finishing tied for second at -13.

items.headline: Higgo Caddie Takes Blame
items.text: Austin Gaugert, Garrick Higgo's caddie, admitted fault for Higgo’s two-stroke penalty for arriving late at the PGA Championship, which contributed to Higgo missing the cut by one stroke.

items.headline: Koepka, Scheffler, Kim Tee Off Friday
items.text: Brooks Koepka, Scottie Scheffler, and Si Woo Kim were paired together with a 1:43 p.m. tee time for Round 2 at the 2026 CJ Cup Byron Nelson.
